title: tephrosia quartiniana var. inflexa
intro: Tephrosia quartiniana var. inflexa, commonly known as the "Khatan Bush", is a plant species within the Fabaceae family, native to various parts of Africa. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Tephrosia quartiniana var. inflexa include its analgesic, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory properties, making it effective in treating pain and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
